description_en: Restricts or unrestricts Upgrade/Downgrade operations on a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance before using Data Transmission Service (DTS) to migrate or synchronize data, preventing data migration or synchronization task failures caused by Upgrade/Downgrade operations. You can invoke this operation to set the restriction
description_zh: 在使用DTS迁移或同步云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的数据前，您可以调用本接口限制该实例执行变配操作，避免因变配引起的数据迁移或同步任务失败
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore sync-dts-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SyncDtsStatus

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restrict specification change operations on the instance. Valid values:
0: No restriction.
1: Restricted. A prompt is displayed to the user when a specification change is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否限制实例执行变配操作，取值：
0：不限制。
1：限制，执行变配时将提示用户
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of DTS. You can view this ID by logging on to the DTS console (https://dts.console.aliyun.com/).
Because an instance may be involved in multiple DTS migration or synchronization tasks at the same time, you can specify this parameter to avoid repeated calls to this operation when you want to remove the specification change restriction on the instance
parameters.help_zh:
DTS的实例ID，您可以登录DTS控制台 (https://dts.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
由于实例可能同时处于多个DTS的迁移或同步任务中时，当您需要取消对实例的变配限制时，您可以传入本参数以避免重复调用本接口
parameters.name: task_id
